name: es30-texture-swizzle-lod
title: Texture swizzle and shader-chosen level of detail
summary: TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R/G/B/A applied to the Table 3.24 base colors of R8, RG8, LUMINANCE_ALPHA, ALPHA and RGBA8 textures and to every lookup function (texture state, not sampler state); textureLod, textureGrad, textureProj(Lod), textureSize and texelFetch counted from TEXTURE_BASE_LEVEL and clamped (or not) by MIN/MAX_LOD; texel offsets at the queried MIN/MAX_PROGRAM_TEXEL_OFFSET in five lookup functions; all against CPU models.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.8.7 Texture Parameters (Table 3.20: swizzle legal values), §3.8.14 Texture State (initial swizzle), Tables 6.9 and 6.10 (per-texture vs per-sampler state)
ES 3.0 §3.9.2.1 Texture Access (swizzle applied to the Table 3.24 base color), Table 3.24
ES 3.0 §2.12.9.2 Texel Fetches, §2.12.9.3 Texture Size Query

ES 3.0 §3.8.10.1 Scale Factor and Level of Detail (equations 3.17-3.19: explicit LOD, clamping by MIN/MAX_LOD, texel offsets), §3.8.10.2 (Table 3.22 wrapping after the offset), §3.8.10.4 Mipmapping (equations 3.23-3.25, BASE_LEVEL/MAX_LEVEL)
ES 3.2 §8.10 Texture Parameters (INVALID_ENUM for an illegal enum value)
GLSL ES 3.00 §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions, §3.2 Character Set (line continuation)

api.glGenTextures: R8, RG8, LUMINANCE_ALPHA, ALPHA, RGBA8 swizzle textures, the 64x16 ladder and the 13x13 chain
api.glBindTexture: texture per cell; the swizzled RGBA8 texture bound to unit 3 together with a sampler
api.glActiveTexture: unit 3 for the sampler cell; sampler uniform holds the unit index
api.glTexImage2D: R8/RG8/LUMINANCE_ALPHA/ALPHA/RGBA8 4x4 uploads (Table 3.24 base colors observed through pixels), 7 hand-made ladder levels and 4 chain levels (observed through textureLod/texelFetch/textureSize)
api.glTexParameteri: TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R/G/B/A (typed overload) with all six legal values, observed in pixels of every lookup function; BASE_LEVEL / MAX_LEVEL / filters / wrap observed through level selection; illegal swizzle values -> INVALID_ENUM
api.glTexParameteriv: vector form of TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_G read back
api.glTexParameterf: TEXTURE_MIN_LOD / MAX_LOD clamp textureLod but not texelFetch (pixels), read back exactly
api.glGetTexParameteriv: initial swizzle (RED, GREEN, BLUE, ALPHA), swizzle round trips, BASE_LEVEL / MAX_LEVEL round trips
api.glGetIntegerv: MIN_PROGRAM_TEXEL_OFFSET / MAX_PROGRAM_TEXEL_OFFSET (queried, checked against Table 6.31 and compiled into the offset shader as constants)
api.glGenSamplers: one sampler object bound to unit 3 over the swizzled texture
api.glSamplerParameteri: LINEAR filters and CLAMP_TO_EDGE of the sampler: the cell is smooth (bilinear CPU model) while the texture's swizzle still applies
api.glBindSampler: sampler on unit 3 overrides the texture's filtering but not its swizzle
api.glUseProgram: swizzle, lod and offset programs; every cell output depends on the program
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_tex, u_lookup, u_func, u_lod, u_dx, u_dy, u_q, u_origin, u_off, u_size located
api.glUniform1i: lookup function, offset selector, sampler unit and level size; observed through the pixels
api.glUniform1f: explicit lod and projective coordinate q
api.glUniform2i: window origin of the cell for texelFetch coordinates
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP quad per cell from gl_VertexID; every pixel of every cell compared
api.glViewport: per-cell viewports (16x16, 13x13, 6x6, 1x1 pixels): texel-for-pixel readouts depend on them
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of every cell, compared with CPU models

visual_review.notes: radeonsi es-max capture viewed at 4-6x (llvmpipe and zink captures differ by at most 1/255; es-min identical). Row 0: sixteen 16x16 cells; the R8 cells show a red ramp, a gray ramp and a solid red (alpha<-red, red<-1), RG8 shows red/green, swapped red/green and a gray/alpha ramp, the LUMINANCE_ALPHA cell looks identical to the RG8 (R,R,R,G) cell, then the black ALPHA cell and its gray version, the RGBA reference, the red/blue-swapped version, the rotated and the constant-channel versions and three more (B,G,R,A) cells identical to the swapped one. Row 1: one smooth (bilinear) swizzled cell. Row 2: solid level colors (blue, red, yellow, white, white, teal blend, yellow, olive blend, green, yellow, yellow, blue, magenta). Row 3: solid colors for the gradient and projective cells. Row 4: dark size-encoding cells. Row 5: three single pixels, then the 13x13 patterned level and its smaller levels. Rows 6-8: 13x13 / 6x6 patterned images, five per function: five mirrored images for texelFetchOffset, then shifted wrapped images and the clamped, streaky ones.
